def extract_hash_tag(key) when is_binary(key) do
  case :binary.match(key, "{") do
    :nomatch ->
      key

    {open_pos, _length = 1} ->
      rest = binary_part(key, open_pos + 1, byte_size(key) - open_pos - 1)

      case :binary.match(rest, "}") do
        :nomatch -> key
        {0, 1} -> key
        {close_offset, 1} -> binary_part(rest, 0, close_offset)
      end
  end
end

  guard_missing_table(
    fn ->
      case :ets.lookup(slot_table, slot) do
        [{^slot, _primary_id, replica_ids}] when replica_ids != [] ->
          replica_ids
          |> Enum.shuffle()
          |> Enum.find_value(:error, fn replica_id ->
            case lookup_connection(registry, replica_id) do
              {:ok, pid} -> {:ok, pid}
              :error -> false
            end
          end)

        _other ->
          :error
      end
    end,
    :error
  )
end

def get_random_connection(registry) do
  guard_missing_table(
    fn ->
      case Registry.select(registry, [{{:_, :"$1", :primary}, [], [:"$1"]}]) do
        [_ | _] = pids ->
          {:ok, Enum.random(pids)}

        [] ->
          case Registry.select(registry, [{{:_, :"$1", :_}, [], [:"$1"]}]) do
            [] -> :error
            pids -> {:ok, Enum.random(pids)}
          end
      end
    end,
    :error
  )
end

def get_connection(slot_table, registry, slot) when is_integer(slot) do
  guard_missing_table(
    fn ->
      case :ets.lookup(slot_table, slot) do
        [{^slot, primary_id, _replica_ids}] -> lookup_connection(registry, primary_id)
        [] -> :error
      end
    end,
    :error
  )
end

def start_link(cluster_opts, connection_opts) do
  {sync_connect_timeout, cluster_opts} = Keyword.pop!(cluster_opts, :sync_connect)
  {gen_statem_opts, cluster_opts} = GenStatemHelpers.split_opts(cluster_opts)

         __MODULE__,
         {cluster_opts, connection_opts, sync_connect_alias_or_nil},

    {:ok, pid} when is_integer(sync_connect_timeout) ->
      receive do
        {^sync_connect_alias_or_nil, :connected} -> {:ok, pid}

          if sync_connect_alias_or_nil do
            Process.unalias(sync_connect_alias_or_nil)
          end

          {:error, :sync_connect_timeout}
      end

    other ->
      other
  end

    when is_integer(token) and is_integer(nr_shards) and nr_shards > 0 and

def hash(data) when is_binary(data) do
  {h1, h2, tail} = hash_blocks(data, 0, 0)
  {k1, k2} = tail_blocks(tail)

  h2 =
    if byte_size(tail) > 8 do
      k2 = k2 |> mul64(@c2) |> rotl64(33) |> mul64(@c1)
      bxor(h2, k2)
    else
      h2
    end

  h1 =
    if byte_size(tail) > 0 do
      k1 = k1 |> mul64(@c1) |> rotl64(31) |> mul64(@c2)
      bxor(h1, k1)
    else
      h1
    end

  h1 = bxor(h1, byte_size(data))
  h2 = bxor(h2, byte_size(data))
  h1 = add64(h1, h2)
  h2 = add64(h2, h1)
  h1 = fmix64(h1)
  h2 = fmix64(h2)
  h1 = add64(h1, h2)
  to_signed64(h1)
end

  index =
    if index == tuple_size(ring) do
      0
    else
      index
    end

  {_token, peername} = elem(ring, index)
  peername
end

def start_link_with_name_registration(module, arg, gen_statem_opts_with_name)
    when is_atom(module) and is_list(gen_statem_opts_with_name) do
  case Keyword.fetch(gen_statem_opts_with_name, :name) do
    :error ->
      :gen_statem.start_link(module, arg, gen_statem_opts_with_name)

    {:ok, atom} when is_atom(atom) ->
      gen_statem_opts = Keyword.delete(gen_statem_opts_with_name, :name)
      :gen_statem.start_link({:local, atom}, module, arg, gen_statem_opts)

    {:ok, {:global, _term} = tuple} ->
      gen_statem_opts = Keyword.delete(gen_statem_opts_with_name, :name)
      :gen_statem.start_link(tuple, module, arg, gen_statem_opts)

    {:ok, {:via, via_module, _term} = tuple} when is_atom(via_module) ->
      gen_statem_opts = Keyword.delete(gen_statem_opts_with_name, :name)
      :gen_statem.start_link(tuple, module, arg, gen_statem_opts)

    {:ok, other} ->
      raise ArgumentError, "expected :name option to be one of the following:

  * nil
  * atom
  * {:global, term}
  * {:via, module, term}

Instead, got: #{inspect(other)}"
  end
end

def validate_custom_payload(term) do
  if is_map(term) and Enum.all?(term, fn {key, val} -> is_binary(key) and is_binary(val) end) do
    {:ok, term}
  else
    {:error, "expected custom payload to be a map of string to binary, got: #{inspect(term)}"}
  end
end

def validate_node(value) when is_binary(value) do
  case Regex.run(~r/^\[([^\]]+)\](?::([^:]+))?$/, value) do
    [_, address] ->
      validate_ipv6_node(address, 9042, value)

    [_, address, port] ->
      with {:ok, port} <- validate_port(port, value) do
        validate_ipv6_node(address, port, value)
      end

    nil ->
      validate_unbracketed_node(value)
  end
end
def validate_node(other) do
  {:error, "expected node to be a \"<host>:<port>\" string, got: #{inspect(other)}"}
end
